- **self**: Agent harnesses on Ollama: OpenClaw / Hermes Agent / Goose / Pi (11/5)

## How it works

- [statement] OpenClaw talks to Ollama's native API (/api/chat), not the OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. Its docs say not to use the /v1 URL because it breaks tool calling and models may print raw tool-call JSON as text. Set `baseUrl` to `http://host:11434` (no /v1); `baseUrl` is the canonical key, `baseURL` is accepted. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/ollama · keywords: Agent harnesses on Ollama: OpenClaw / Hermes Agent / Goose / Pi · also: https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/openclaw.md

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Hermes docs list gemma4:31b as the only model in their table with reliable tool calling (others chat-only); models without tool support cannot take actions. Long silence on first response is prefill of the large fixed prompt, documented as expected, not a hang. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/guides/local-ollama-setup · keywords: Agent harnesses on Ollama: OpenClaw / Hermes Agent / Goose / Pi

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Manual Hermes setup uses `hermes setup` -> Custom Endpoint with base URL `http://localhost:11434/v1`, or `model.provider: custom` and `model.base_url` in ~/.hermes/config.yaml. Using `--provider ollama` without `providers.ollama.base_url` fails with "provider 'ollama' has no endpoint configured" rather than falling back to OpenRouter. Hermes sets stream read timeout to 1800s for local endpoints; `HERMES_API_TIMEOUT=1800` goes in ~/.hermes/.env; `OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=24h` avoids the 5-minute unload. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/guides/local-ollama-setup · keywords: Agent harnesses on Ollama: OpenClaw / Hermes Agent / Goose / Pi

## Facts and statements

- [statement] `ollama launch openclaw` installs OpenClaw via npm if missing, shows a security notice, lets the user pick a model, configures the provider, installs the gateway daemon, enables bundled Ollama web search, then opens the OpenClaw TUI. `--config` changes the model without starting; `--model X --yes` is headless and auto-pulls (requires --model). `ollama launch clawdbot` remains an alias (OpenClaw's former name). (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/openclaw.md · keywords: Agent harnesses on Ollama: OpenClaw / Hermes Agent / Goose / Pi · also: https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/ollama
- [statement] Ollama recommends a context window of at least 64k tokens for OpenClaw with local models; the Hermes docs state Hermes requires at least 64,000 tokens for agentic work with tools and that Ollama defaults to 2048. Hermes fix: a Modelfile with `PARAMETER num_ctx 64000` and `ollama create`, then point Hermes at the new model. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/openclaw.md · keywords: Agent harnesses on Ollama: OpenClaw / Hermes Agent / Goose / Pi · also: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/guides/local-ollama-setup
- [statement] OpenClaw's Ollama provider supports three setups: Cloud + Local (an Ollama host serving local models and, if signed in, :cloud models), Local only, and direct Ollama Cloud at https://ollama.com via the `ollama-cloud` provider with no daemon (model refs `ollama-cloud/<model>`). (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/ollama · keywords: Agent harnesses on Ollama: OpenClaw / Hermes Agent / Goose / Pi
- [statement] `ollama launch hermes` installs the Hermes CLI agent if absent, lets the user choose a local or cloud model, configures the Ollama provider against the local OpenAI-compatible endpoint, optionally connects a messaging gateway, then starts Hermes chat. Later changes use `hermes model`; messaging uses `hermes gateway setup`. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/hermes.md · keywords: Agent harnesses on Ollama: OpenClaw / Hermes Agent / Goose / Pi · also: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/guides/local-ollama-setup
- [statement] `ollama launch pi` installs Pi if needed, configures Ollama as a provider including web tools (`@ollama/pi-web-search`), and opens a session; `--config` configures only, `--model qwen3.5:cloud` picks a model. Pi ships four core tools (read, write, edit, bash); everything else comes from extensions. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/pi.md · keywords: Agent harnesses on Ollama: OpenClaw / Hermes Agent / Goose / Pi
- [statement] Manual Pi config: ~/.pi/agent/models.json gets an `ollama` provider with base URL http://localhost:11434/v1, api `openai-completions`, key `ollama`; ~/.pi/agent/settings.json sets the default provider and model. Ollama's page names the package `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/pi.md · keywords: Agent harnesses on Ollama: OpenClaw / Hermes Agent / Goose / Pi
- [statement] Goose has a built-in Ollama provider. For models without native tool calling, an experimental tool shim (enabled with `GOOSE_TOOLSHIM=true goose session`) uses an interpreter model, default `mistral-nemo` (`ollama pull mistral-nemo`), to turn the primary model's output into tool calls. The docs say behavior and configuration may change. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://goose-docs.ai/docs/experimental/ollama · keywords: Agent harnesses on Ollama: OpenClaw / Hermes Agent / Goose / Pi
- [statement] OpenClaw has a serious exposure record: SecurityScorecard STRIKE counted ~40,000 internet-reachable instances in early Feb 2026, with reported RCE-exploitable hosts. Treat any OpenClaw on Ollama as needing a loopback-only gateway and sandboxing. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-02-09) — https://siliconangle.com/2026/02/09/tens-thousands-openclaw-systems-exposed-due-misconfiguration-known-exploits/ · keywords: Agent harnesses on Ollama: OpenClaw / Hermes Agent / Goose / Pi · also: https://infosecurity-magazine.com/news/researchers-40000-exposed-openclaw/
